known_limitations: The board is intentionally read-only and derives service state only from existing catalog, dependency matrix, health registry, validation, and source-link metadata.
It does not probe live services, create a new source of truth, or fabricate missing operational status.
Runtime JSON output is generated locally at runtime/services/service_status_board.json and is not committed when runtime outputs are ignored by repository policy.
pull_request_url is null until the PR is created.
pull_request_not_applicable_reason: Live PR metadata unavailable in local-first historical validation; completion evidence derived from repository artifacts.
summary: Implemented the Operations Center Service Status Board as a read-only aggregation of the Estate Service Catalog, Service Dependency Matrix, and Service Health Registry. The board exposes healthy, degraded, blocked, unavailable, and unknown states with readiness, validation, dependency summaries, quiet-refresh metadata, and drill-down/source artifact links for Alfred and future Operations Center UI use.
tests_run: PYTHONPATH=src pytest -q tests/test_service_status_board.py tests/test_service_health_registry.py tests/test_service_dependency_matrix.py tests/test_estate_service_catalog.py
